OpenAI CEO Sam Altman on AI risks and benefits

Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, stated that the world should accept "bad things" such as hacks and scams in exchange for the benefits of artificial intelligence. He also cautioned against treating AI as a deity, in what appeared to be a criticism of rival Anthropic. Altman advocated for a light regulatory approach to AI development, emphasizing the potential positive outcomes of the technology.
